metadata.disclaimer: This is a simulation built on stated assumptions. It is not a prediction, a promise or financial advice. Real returns change over time and you can lose money, especially with shares. Check current rates and tax rules before you invest.

mmf.name: Money Market Fund
mmf.description: Low-risk savings that pool money into short-term loans to government and banks. Ideal for emergency funds and short-term goals.
mmf.range_label: across the 27 funds in our list
mmf.source: Average gross yield of 27 Kenyan money market funds (project dataset). Volatility is the spread between funds, not a measured month-to-month swing.
notes: Fund yields move with Treasury rates. Treasury bill rates were lower in 2026 than the dataset suggests, so check the fund's current yield.

tbill.name: Treasury Bill
tbill.description: Short-term government securities (91, 182 or 364 days). The government pays you back at maturity, so the return is known when you buy.
tbill.source: Central Bank of Kenya weekly bulletin, 29 May 2026: average auction rates 91-day 8.388%, 182-day 8.250%, 364-day 8.627%.
notes: Rates change every week. Check the latest auction results at the Central Bank of Kenya.

bond.name: Government Bond
bond.description: Longer-term government securities that pay interest twice a year. Held to maturity the return is known. Selling early can lose money if rates have risen.
bond.as_of: late 2025 yield data, auctions to May 2026
bond.source: 10-year yield of 13.13% in the project dataset (November 2025); Central Bank bond auctions in April-May 2026 ranged 12.46%-13.76%. Volatility is an estimate of price swings if sold early (about 6 x a typical 1 percentage point yearly yield change), not a measured figure.
notes: The tax rate used is the 10% rate for bonds of 10 years or more. Shorter bonds are usually taxed at 15%. Infrastructure bonds have their own rules.

stock.name: Stock Market
stock.description: Part-ownership of listed companies. Higher potential growth, but prices can fall a lot and stay low for years.
stock.range_label: not shown: stock outcomes vary too widely
stock.source: NSE daily prices 2013-01 to 2020-12, month-end, equal-weighted basket of about 54 listed shares (indices and thinly traded months removed). Price change only plus an ASSUMED 5.0% a year for dividends (not in the data, not verified). A single share is far riskier: its typical volatility is 37%.
notes: Dividend tax and tax on selling gains are not modelled. Share prices can fall and stay low for a long time.
